versions.changelog:
personwise-customer-education 2.1.9

- Updated attribution and version references to 2.1.9.
- Clarified installation/update approval: Skill may install or update the PersonWise CLI only with explicit user approval.
- Strengthened instructions to use only the market-bound CLI/service, unless the user explicitly requests otherwise.
- Narrowed scope: other course-creation requests are handled only by explicit user request with this Skill.
- Added allowed-tools and permissions (Bash) to SKILL.md.
- Removed redundant or outdated documentation (skill-card.md).

personwise-customer-education 2.1.8

- Updated SKILL.md with detailed workflow instructions and safety guidance, specifying evidence-locked, grounded course content.
- Clarified course focus: interactive digital-human training based exclusively on supplied materials, avoiding unsupported facts or diagnostic claims.
- Added stricter CLI version and contract checks, with explicit freshness-update behavior and enforcement.
- Outlined precise requirements for course workflow, CLI usage, authentication, and update/approval flow, including user interaction restrictions.
- Enhanced attribution and authorization procedures, ensuring user-requested content and course credit handling aligns with security and governance rules.
